howto.name: Calculate the hashes
howto.text: One click gives SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 side by side. SHA-256 is the modern recommendation.

howto.name: Copy the hex digest
howto.text: Runs entirely in your browser using the Web Crypto API. Input never leaves your machine.

faq.a: No. The browser's Web Crypto API has no MD5, so this tool calculates SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512. MD5 and SHA-1 are both broken for security uses such as signatures; use SHA-256 or SHA-512.
Verifying file integrity after download, deduplication, change detection, content-addressed storage.

faq.q: Is the hash calculation done in the browser?
faq.a: Yes — Web Crypto API runs the hash in your browser. Files are not uploaded.
